p.i: mum datum in secundum, & produstum divide per ter tium, & quotus erit numerus quæfitus.

main_text.p: 1. Ut in exemplo propofito, tres dati (ut in regulâ di- rectâ) fic difponantur,

duc igitur primum 25 in secundum 16, & productum 400 divide per tertium 46, & quotus erit 8 2/46, quo residuo juxta priorem regulam in minores species reducto, totus quotiens erit d.8. h.16. 41'. Adeo ut si operarii 25 diebus 16 opus aliquid absolvant, idem absolvent operarii 46 d. 8. h.16. 41'.

2. Hæc autem regula inversa rarioris si ullius est usus in Chronologiâ, ut & utraque regula proportionum composita, quas itaque unà cum radicibus, aliisque operationibus Arithmeticis (ut quibus Chronologo non opus est) missas confulto facimus.

page.notes: Catchword and signature are not on this part; the text continues beyond the visible area. Fraction in paragraph 1 rendered approximately as printed (8 with stacked 2 over 46). Part 2 of 2 of the page: the upper text is cut off, only the first line's tail survives. The rule across the page and the faint "Google" watermark at lower right are not printed text. The word "confulto" is read as printed "confulto" with long s rendered as s; the initial letter is unclear. "EXER-" is a catchword broken at the line end, given as a paragraph since it is not a heading.
